journey.title: Think First! 💭
journey.studentText: For 3 × 4, think: 4 + 4 + 4 = 12. For 4 × 3, think: 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 = 12. Same answer!
journey.owlText: Take a moment to think about multiplying by 3 and 4. What do you already know? There's no wrong answer!
